prerequisites: Elementary knowledge of Mechanics and Manufacturing is desirable.
Basic notions of Linear Algebra are advisable.
Basic notions of Differential and Integral Calculus are advisable.
Basic notions of Numerical Methods are advisable.
Basic notions of Mechanical Technology are advisable.

learning_outcomes.text: Perceive planning as an important stage between design and manufacturing.
Determine forces and stresses in simple mechatronic components.
Acquire the necessary knowledge to design machine elements.

syllabus_topics: Machine Elements and Mechatronic Systems (6.0 ECTS)

assessment_methods.method: Machine Elements and Mechatronic Systems course (MMECAT03-C-006)

assessment_rules: To pass "Mechanical Design and Manufacturing I", students must pass both local courses: "CAD/CAE" and "Machine Elements and Mechatronic Systems". The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * CAD grade + 0.5 * Machine Elements and Mechatronic Systems grade. If the requirement of passing both courses is not met, the final grade will be FAIL, and the numerical grade will be the weighted average or 4.0, whichever is lower. If a student does not attend the exam for either of the two local courses, the final grade will be NOT PRESENTED (NP); if they attend one but not the other, the final grade will be FAIL.
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Erasmus Mundus en Ingeniería Mecatrónica (EPI Gijón)
